content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

When evaluating platforms like PayPal and Stripe, it’s clear they cater to a limited audience, operating in only 46 countries out of 195 globally. This exclusion leaves many creators without viable payment options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive solution that doesn’t depend on traditional payment processors. By utilizing crypto payment systems, creators gain full operational control over their sales without the risk of account suspension or fund holds that PayPal users often face, which can last up to 180 days.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal often leave creators in restricted countries stranded, unable to access their services due to regional policies. This results in lost sales and frustrated users. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is built on principles of accessibility and ownership. With tools like NOWPayments, creators can process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, bypassing the limitations imposed by traditional platforms. This ensures that no matter where you are, you have a direct line to your customers and their funds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment processing speed of traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe can be frustrating, often taking days to settle transactions. Additionally, the fees can add up quickly, especially in low-value transactions. Sovereign commerce solutions, like the ones provided by COREMERCH, feature minimal fees—just 0.5% with NOWPayments—and transactions on recommended networks such as BSC or Solana can cost under $0.10. This means more money in your pocket and quicker access to your funds, allowing you to reinvest in your digital products.
Complete ownership means no more worrying about account suspensions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the major drawbacks of using platforms like PayPal or Gumroad is the lack of true ownership over your digital assets. Once you deploy through these platforms, you are often subject to their terms and conditions, which can change at any time. Sovereign commerce infrastructure flips this narrative on its head. You maintain complete ownership and control over your products, and with automated systems for payment verification and product delivery, you can sell without the constant worry of a suspended account or service interruption.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re a digital creator in a restricted country, the choice is clear: adopt sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers comprehensive documentation to set up your own sales stack, giving you the tools to implement your own payment processing and delivery system. Whether you need a simple setup with the Sovereign Starter Stack or a more robust Edge Commerce Stack, the architecture designed for creators like you ensures you’re not at the mercy of unreliable platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With sovereign commerce, you control your infrastructure, not the other way around.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

Traditional platforms can suspend accounts, hold funds for extended periods, and change terms without notice. This unpredictability poses a risk to your sales and overall business stability.

NOWPayments allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. It offers automatic payment verification with minimal fees, ensuring you receive your funds quickly and securely.
